falling_star_rewards.configuration.gener: The general settings for Falling Star Rewards. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than the specified value will be able to access the settings.
falling_star_rewards.configuration.enabl: Enable or disable the Falling Star Rewards feature. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to access the feature.
Enable or disable the generation of presets for Falling Star Rewards. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to access the feature.
Enabled Schedules for Falling Star Drops
Enable or disable the scheduled falling star drops feature. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to access the feature.
falling_star_rewards.configuration.maxAc: Set the maximum number of active falling star drops. Players with a permission level equal to or higher than this value will be able to access the feature.
